Table with colspan attribute in a header cell

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<table><thead><tr><th colspan=\"2\">Full Name</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>John</td><td>Doe</td></tr></tbody></table>", null);
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
